recipe.visualDefinition: A split-composition layout featuring a vibrant red upper section with a jagged, torn-paper bottom edge that reveals a black-and-white photograph of a 1960s house party and band performance below. The design uses high-contrast typography and a distinct collage aesthetic.
coreVisualRelationships: Torn paper edge separating the solid color field from the photographic scene
Contrast between the saturated red header and the grayscale lower image
Dynamic interplay between formal serif body text and expressive script display text
Vertical hierarchy moving from descriptive text to band name to visual action
coreInvariants: Jagged, irregular white 'torn' border between sections
High-contrast black and white photography for the lower half
Solid, flat red background for the upper half
Drop shadows on the primary script lettering

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The band and party-goers occupy the lower 60% of the frame in a wide-angle interior shot. The text dominates the top 40%.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, yellow-to-orange script band name centered horizontally just above the torn edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down flow: starting with the white serif description, moving to the italicized sub-header, landing on the script band name, and finally descending into the photographic scene.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The solid red header provides significant breathing room for the text, contrasting with the busy, detailed photographic scene below.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the top half vs. zero saturation in the bottom half creates a stark, modern-retro tension.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Mix of slab-serif, italicized sans-serif, and brush script
letterConstructionRules: Upper text uses a high-waisted, rounded slab serif with open counters
Sub-header uses a slanted, condensed sans-serif with a slight drop shadow
Main title uses a fluid, casual brush script with connected lowercase and sharp flourishes
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'K' in the script has a long, sweeping descender
The 'T' in the script features a wide, horizontal crossbar that overlaps the following letters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Triadic mix of formal serif, energetic italic, and expressive script to mimic mid-century advertising.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sturdy, rounded slab-serif feel of the top text
Captures the mid-century casual script energy

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a split-screen image. The top 40% is a solid vibrant red field. The bottom 60% is a high-contrast black and white photograph of a 1960s indoor party with a rock band performing. The two sections are separated by a jagged, white torn-paper edge that looks physically ripped.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three levels of text centered in the red section. Top: three lines of white slab-serif text. Middle: one line of slanted orange-red sans-serif text with a shadow. Bottom: two lines of large yellow brush-script text with a black drop shadow.

verificationChecks: Is the torn edge irregular and white?
Is the photo strictly black and white?
Is the red header a flat, solid color?
Are there three distinct font styles used?
Does the script text have a visible drop shadow?

adjustableVariables: Tear intensity of the paper edge
mustRedesign: Modern technology in the background photo

mustAchieve: High contrast between red and grayscale
avoid: Digital-only filters like glow or bevel

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not overlap the torn edge excessively
Check that the script font looks hand-drawn rather than geometric
Verify the grayscale photo has deep blacks and bright whites
Confirm the red is a warm, primary-leaning shade
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a solid color header with a torn-edge transition into a grayscale action photo, using a mix of slab-serif and script typography to evoke 1960s garage rock aesthetics.
